text:
Which list shows the fractions obtained from the fractional distillation of petroleum, in order of
increasing boiling point?
bitumen → diesel oil → fuel oil → lubricating oil
A
diesel oil → gasoline → naphtha → kerosene
B
gasoline → naphtha → kerosene → diesel oil
C
kerosene → lubricating oil → naphtha → refinery gas
D

options.label: A
options.text: bitumen → diesel oil → fuel oil → lubricating oil

options.label: D
options.text: kerosene → lubricating oil → naphtha → refinery gas
